ops.title: 2026-07-05 yasyf-home FP wedge: fleet --force migrate under live sessions → 4-defect chain (cutover-before-ready, global Swift try-lock, backoff-less reconcile, invisible wedge); fixed fusekit v0.31.0 + cc-pool v0.43.0; VM replay CLEAN; full record ccn doc 0bfd570
ops.body:
2026-07-05: fleet `ccp migrate --to fileprovider --force` under live sessions wedged all 10
yasyf-home accounts for ~2h (domain-busy storm, reads hung, sessions showed the login screen).
Root cause was a 4-defect chain, all cc-pool's own: (1) cutover before domain readiness (no FP
waitMounted analog → 10 domains materializing at once); (2) the Swift control server's single
global zero-timeout try-lock minting "domain busy" for every account (violating its own
per-domain ClassBusy wire contract); (3) backoff-less reconcile + same-tick retry amplifier;
(4) control-plane-only Health making the wedge invisible. Remediation that worked: fleet retreat
to symlink (always safe). Remediation that did NOT: killall fileproviderd / daemon kickstarts —
because the group-container consent re-prompts after EVERY upgrade (cdhash-keyed) and launchd
never surfaces it, so the bridge bind parks invisibly ([[fp-backend-rollout]] fact 2).

**Why:** forced fleet cutovers were unsafe by construction, and nothing detected or healed the
resulting wedge.

**How to apply:** never diagnose "domain busy" as fileproviderd's — it's cc-pool's own gate
(per-domain claims since v0.43.0). A wedged FP domain now self-heals (fpstate ladder) or yields
to `ccp fp repair`. Fleet migrates settle account-by-account through the readiness gate
(fusekit v0.31.0 WaitDomainServes + data-plane probe before the row flips) — --force semantics
unchanged, cutover safe by construction. Incident replay lives at
claude-pool/scripts/vm (`vmctl run scenarios/replay-fp-migrate-storm.sh`, EXPECT=clean; verdict
CLEAN 2026-07-05, archived to the cc-pool vm-repro chronology). Full record: `ccn doc show
0bfd570`. yasyf-home re-enable is the user's call, after v0.43.0 + the onboard consent flow
([[fp-backend-rollout]]).
